title: World’s Fastest Human-Powered Bike Speed Record #shorts
description:
Learn how student teams in the Human Powered Vehicle Challenge have pushed bicycles past 60 km/h and discover the design tricks behind the world’s fastest human-powered vehicle. We also reveal where the official record was set.

Sources (Wikipedia, CC BY-SA):
- Human-powered transport: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human-powered_transport
- Human Powered Vehicle Challenge: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_Powered_Vehicle_Challenge

Narration is a synthetic voice. Script and visuals are produced with AI tools and checked by automated quality gates.

meta.topic: World’s Fastest Human-Powered Vehicle Speed Record

scenes.say: Can a bike smash sixty km/h using only human power?
Student teams in the HPVC have topped sixty km/h, but the official record was set at the World Human Powered Speed Challenge.
How does that stack up against a regular bike?
The HPVC began in nineteen eighty-three, and speeds have risen steadily.
These sleek machines look more like rockets than bicycles.
So yes, with the right design a bike can crush sixty km/h on pure muscle power.
Watch the next record shatter to stay tuned!
